body:
Resolve five adversarial review findings:
1. Prevent command injection in auto-approve-tests.mjs by checking for shell metacharacters (; & | < > $ ` \n).
2. Add '.agents/' to files whitelist in package.json.
3. Correct bootstrap error flag so it does not report failure if the jetski install fallback succeeds.
4. Delete the duplicate hook lib/hooks/auto-approve-tests.mjs and update tests to use the active plugin copy.
5. Implement process tracking and cleanup on exit/close in the MCP server.
title: bugfix(hook): fix command injection in auto-approve hook and resolve packaging/bootstrap bugs
